# JIRA-005: Frames, DOM and Advanced Mouse Interactions

## Description

Testing of iFrames, nested frames, shadow DOM traversal, virtual DOM rendering, and advanced mouse interactions (hover, drag, context menu, overlapped elements). Covers complex DOM scenarios and user actions.

## Pages Covered

| #   | Page Name           | URL Path              |
| --- | ------------------- | --------------------- |
| 1   | iFrame Demo         | `/iframe-demo`        |
| 2   | Nested Frames       | `/nested-frames`      |
| 3   | Shadow DOM          | `/shadow-dom`         |
| 4   | Virtual DOM         | `/virtual-dom`        |
| 5   | Hover Demo          | `/hover-demo`         |
| 6   | Drag and Drop       | `/drag-and-drop`      |
| 7   | Drag & Drop Sliders | `/drag-drop-sliders`  |
| 8   | Context Menu        | `/context-menu`       |
| 9   | Overlapped Element  | `/overlapped-element` |

## What to Handle

- iFrame content access and interaction
- Nested frame navigation and element lookup
- Shadow DOM element selection and interaction
- Virtual DOM re-rendering detection
- Hover effects and tooltips
- Drag and drop operations (elements and sliders)
- Context menu (right-click) trigger and interaction
- Clicking through overlapped/layered elements
- Element visibility and interactivity states

## Acceptance Criteria

- ✅ All 9 pages accessible
- ✅ iFrame content can be accessed and elements interacted with
- ✅ Nested frames properly navigated
- ✅ Shadow DOM elements located and verified
- ✅ Virtual DOM updates detected and validated
- ✅ Hover actions trigger state changes
- ✅ Drag and drop operations complete successfully
- ✅ Sliders move to correct positions
- ✅ Context menu appears and options selectable
- ✅ Overlapped elements can be clicked through/around
- ✅ All tests use `setup('<page name>')` fixture
- ✅ Page objects created for complex interactions
- ✅ Assertions separate in dedicated files

## Out of Scope

- Cross-origin iframe testing (assumes same-origin)
- Shadow DOM polyfill/fallback for older browsers
- Virtual DOM framework-specific optimizations
- Context menu browser-default behavior
- Pointer device-specific features (precision, pressure)

_Test cases will be generated by the planner agent._

## Implementation Notes

- Create frame-handling.ts page object for iFrame/frame interactions
- Create mouse-interactions.ts page object for hover, drag, context menu
- Create dom-assertions.ts for visibility and state assertions
- Handle `frameLocator()` for iFrame access
- Test cases numbered JIRA-005.1, JIRA-005.2, etc.
- Use `page.dragAndDrop()` for drag operations
- Use `locator.hover()` and mouse actions for hover effects
